nodes.description: owner: current owner address of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender in the constructor and changed by acceptOwnership
newOwner: pending owner address stored by transferOwnership and cleared by acceptOwnership
symbol: public token symbol string initialized to $GEC in the GlobaleCash constructor
name: public token name string initialized in the GlobaleCash constructor
decimals: public uint8 token decimals value set in the constructor
_totalSupply: total token supply minted to the deployer address in the constructor
balances: mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor
allowed: nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) holding ERC20 allowances, mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall
safeAdd(uint a, uint b): pure arithmetic helper performing checked addition
safeSub(uint a, uint b): pure arithmetic helper performing checked subtraction
safeMul(uint a, uint b): pure arithmetic helper performing checked multiplication
safeDiv(uint a, uint b): pure arithmetic helper performing checked division
Owned(): constructor of the Owned contract assigning msg.sender as owner
transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner function staging a new owner in newOwner
acceptOwnership(): lets the pending newOwner take ownership and clears newOwner
GlobaleCash(): constructor initializing metadata, supply and the initial balance of the deployer address
totalSupply(): constant getter returning _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0)
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): constant getter returning the balances entry of tokenOwner
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender balance to the to balance using SafeMath
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes the caller allowance for spender into allowed
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends an allowance and moves balances using SafeMath with no allowance/balance revert checks
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): constant getter returning the allowed mapping entry
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets the allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract
fallback function(): payable fallback that always reverts, refusing plain ETH transfers
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner rescue that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 contract
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for ownership checks, allowance keys and balance keys
c = a + b inside safeAdd: unchecked in isolation, guarded by require(c >= a)
c = a - b inside safeSub: unchecked in isolation, guarded by require(b <= a)
c = a * b inside safeMul: unchecked in isolation, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
c = a / b inside safeDiv: division guarded by require(b > 0)
external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) invoking attacker-controlled code after allowance state update
external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an owner-supplied token contract
